title: Elicitation Prompt
description: A mid-tool-call user prompt issued by MCP elicitation/create (spec 2025-06-18). Rendered inline in chat with a text input (string schema) or accept/decline buttons (boolean schema).

elicitation_id.description: Unique ID of the pending elicitation request. Must be echoed back in the response.

message.description: The question or prompt shown to the user.

schema_type.description: Response type: boolean renders accept/decline buttons; string renders a text input.

schema_title.description: Optional short label shown above the input widget.

schema_description.description: Optional helper text shown below the input widget.

tool_call_id.description: Originating tool-call ID (MCP tool_use_id) for client-side correlation.

origin.description: Where the elicitation was issued: server (Nanite's own tool) or client (external MCP server).

timeout_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the server will auto-cancel if no response arrives (default: 5 min from creation).
